command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Two-by-two graded plate, T=305+x+t, unit conductivity and unit depth. Row-dependent ambient excess switches from pattern to -2*pattern at 0.125 s. Exact bulk heat through 0.5 s is -0.625*pattern*H*volume. Independent heater plus bulk exchange supplies C*volume/2. Compare cell heat, field and budgets under CN and Rannacher. For the unit single-cell weak-heater test the discrete CN mean temperature excess is dt*P/(2+5*dt), P=2^-50 W. Heat diagnostics retain this response although absolute temperature rounds at 305 K. Mixed storing-Robin and Neumann boundaries also checked under a 305 K reference shift.
